findings.observation: The entire pommel, grip, guard, blade, and point are visible and clear the 8% safe margin, narrowly at the upper pommel.
Exactly one complete dagger is present with no sheath, second weapon, or extra gear.
The compact single-hand grip, short crossguard, and broad double-edged thrusting blade read as a fighting dagger.
Blade, shoulders, guard, wrapped grip, and capped pommel align around a credible full-tang weapon construction.
The broad blade reads as ordinary silver-grey steel while the visibly sun-associated material is confined to a narrow gold inlay and emblem, so sunsteel does not visually dominate.
A literal sun emblem and gold-colored center line carry the identity as decoration rather than one or two physical sunsteel construction cues beyond palette.
Warm emission is confined to the emblem and narrow central line; the blade and whole object do not glow.
Premium realistic painterly finish, honest scratches, narrow highlights, cold key, warm rim, charcoal backdrop, floor plane, and grounded construction match the accepted profile.

The image avoids subject transfer, published-character resemblance, rarity rainbow, gold inflation, full-object glow, oversized silhouette, extra gear, text, labels, UI, border, frame, logo, and watermark, but violates no-ornament-as-material-identity through its literal sun emblem.
